title: BLIND-1: The First Blind-Adversarial Attack Battery — Attacks Authored by an Entity That Did Not Design the Defenses, Conditions Honored Verbatim, 2 of 6 Attacks Succeeded and Are Published With the Forward-Only Fix and a Verified 6/6 Re-Run
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. Not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic.

BLIND-1: the first blind-adversarial battery — attacks authored by an entity that did not design the defenses. Following the HACK series (HACK-1 to HACK-18, 109/109 preregistered falsifiers, master compilation DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23430655) and the randomized pop quiz SBR-6 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23431194), both designed and graded by the builder, this battery breaks the designer-tests-designer loop: a context-independent engine instance was given ONLY a digest of the seven published claims and authored six attack batteries with its own binary ATTACKER-SUCCESS and REPELLED conditions, instructed to be genuinely adversarial. The specs were frozen verbatim (commit 0c86e94) BEFORE any harness existed; the protocol preregistration was frozen before the specs were read; adjudication was deterministic (no LLM in the decision path) against the real frozen PORTCULLIS gate code, honoring the attacker's conditions exactly as written — no softening.

RESULT, PUBLISHED AS IT HAPPENED: 4/6 attacks repelled, 2/6 ATTACKER SUCCESSES. The blind attacker's highest-confidence attack (0.85, PORTCULLIS-KEM-AUTH) landed: the published gate attests crypto-policy compliance, not submitter authority — KEM crossings are not role-bound from signature/authorization tasks. REPLAY-KEY-DESYNC (0.80) also landed: nonce consumption on ADMITTED-only left a burn-on-parse gap. Neither had been surfaced by the 109 self-designed falsifiers. Both were hardening findings, not live exploitations (the deployed sender-identity gate and human-ACK rules cover both in the production stack).

REMEDIATION, RECEIPTED END TO END: SelfImprovementProposals SIP-023 (algorithm-role binding) and SIP-024 (burn-on-parse nonce consumption) were filed and approved through the human approval cycle (owner ACK, chat authorization 2026-10-17). PORTCULLIS v1.1 was amended forward-only (the v1.0 evidence untouched). A pre-publication authoring defect in the fix itself (the authorization_ref corollary read a field the journal never records) was caught by the verification run and disclosed. The UNCHANGED frozen attack specs were then re-run: 6/6 REPELLED (receipt 0bcefc2d). The v1.0 failure receipt (9c1008fb) stands permanently on the append-only record next to the fix.

Disclosed limitations (load-bearing): the blind author is the same model family as the defender engine but context-blind — this breaks the information asymmetry, not the vendor asymmetry; verdicts on execution remain self-graded (deterministic, receipted). Dual Mesh Benchmark status: MEASURED (scoped) — DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637 (DeepSeek column 10.5281/zenodo.23345241; cross-engine expansion 10.5281/zenodo.23348675). Provenance: append-only ledger entries 0147-0149, github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen. DCAI community: zenodo.org/communities/dcai. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-17 ~00:46 CT).
